days.title: Day 1 — Fly Orlando to London
days.subtitle: Tue Aug 4 • Plane • Norse Atlantic Z0 784 MCO → LGW
days.tip: Pack, rest, sleep on the plane. Set watches to UK time on board — London is 5 hours ahead of Florida. Confirm UK ETA online for all 5 travelers at gov.uk before departure. You land at 10:00 AM tomorrow and the day continues immediately.
